cause: EventProcessor removes a due event from its list before calling Execute. A false return does not delete or automatically requeue it. Four local early guards (five machine rejection edges: absent passenger-world, absent target lookup, target outside world, missing kit, missing control aura) returned false without re-adding the event. It therefore escaped normal queue destruction and later KillAllEvents; Abort's caster-specific aura/accessory cleanup never ran. Pending registry and retained object references could outlive the failed request. This is a native controlled reproduction, not an observed client crash or proven cause of a reported client flight failure.

Preserve original null/IsInWorld/RecAura/caster gates and all successful publication, pet, gravity/root, transport/spline, AI/script and collision paths. Its unavailable-target diagnostic now reports the saved target GUID instead of dereferencing a possibly invalid Seat iterator after the target/kit is gone; logging and passenger/target identity remain, not suppressed.
